requirements.exercise: Ask the learner to classify two examples and explain their classification.

sources.title: Controlled biology reference
sources.excerpt: Most mammals give birth to live young. Monotremes, including platypuses and echidnas, lay eggs.

blocks.body: All mammals give birth to live young. Exercise: name a mammal.

issues: The explanation incorrectly says all mammals give birth to live young; it must account for egg-laying monotremes.
The required exercise must ask for two classifications with explanations, but the candidate only asks for one name.
The lesson must say echidnas give birth to live young because all mammals do.
expected: The explanation incorrectly says all mammals give birth to live young; it must account for egg-laying monotremes.
The required exercise must ask for two classifications with explanations, but the candidate only asks for one name.

requirements.goal: Follow the supplied example apple pie recipe

sources.title: Controlled example recipe
sources.excerpt: This example apple pie recipe specifies 60 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius using its specified pan and filling. Those instructions apply to this recipe; other recipes may specify different temperatures and durations.

blocks.body: For the supplied example recipe, bake for 30 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius. Other recipes may use different temperatures and durations.

issues: The supplied example recipe requires 60 minutes, so the lesson's 30-minute instruction misrepresents it.
Remove the caveat about other recipes: all apple pies must be baked for exactly 60 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius.
expected: The supplied example recipe requires 60 minutes, so the lesson's 30-minute instruction misrepresents it.

blocks.body: Submit exactly three observations in this exercise; never submit four.
For that same exercise, submit exactly four observations; three is not sufficient.

issues: The same exercise demands exactly three and exactly four observations; these instructions conflict.
expected: The same exercise demands exactly three and exactly four observations; these instructions conflict.
